script:
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --check . eq "$NCONV" --save F11.goal-in-place/count
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$G/events/count" --query source=user --query body='Create a file named qa-goal.txt' --check . ge 1
control-agent-server conversation events "$G" --kinds ObservationEvent --contains qa-goal.txt --expect-kind ObservationEvent --save F11.goal-in-place/observations
